metadata.title: fix(ui): preserve tag filters across page navigation on Virtual Servers
metadata.author: Nayana-R-Gowda

description:
Signed-off-by: NAYANA.R <nayana.r7813@gmail.com>
closes #3662 
## 💡 Fix Description

Fixed tag loss issue on Virtual Servers page by correcting input IDs from catalog-* to servers-*.

Ensured tag filter values persist by updating hx-vals to use the correct hidden inputs.

Added data-tag attribute to tag elements for reliable tag extraction after UI updates.

Improved HTMX lifecycle handling using htmx:afterSwap and htmx:afterSettle events.

Re-initialized search inputs and restored filter state after dynamic content reloads.

Introduced tableToEntityType mapping to handle tag updates across different panels.

Enhanced tag extraction logic to dynamically read tags from the updated DOM.

Synced search query and tag filters with URL state for consistency across navigation.

Triggered panel reload when filters are present to maintain UI state.

Overall, ensured tags remain visible and consistent when navigating between pages.

reviews.body: Approved after rebasing, fixing the tag filter ID resolution bug, adding data-tag to all partial templates, normalizing filterEntitiesByTags onto the data-tag contract, and adding 24 regression tests. All 938 JS tests passing.

commits.message:
fix(ui): resolve tag filter regression from ID rename and add data-tag to all partials

The rename from catalog-* to servers-* IDs broke addTagToFilter and
clearTagFilter for the catalog entity type because those functions used
the ${entityType}-tag-filter pattern which resolves to catalog-tag-filter.
Fix by resolving the tag input ID from PANEL_SEARCH_CONFIG when available.

Additionally, extractAvailableTags was refactored to use [data-tag] selectors
but data-tag attributes were only added to servers_partial.html, silently
breaking tag extraction for tools, resources, prompts, gateways, and agents.
Add data-tag attributes to all partial templates for consistency.

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
commits.author: Mihai Criveti

commits.message:
test(ui): add tests for data-tag extraction, URL state sync, and HTMX event mapping

Covers the new extractAvailableTags data-tag paths (catalog special case
and generic entity panels), updateAvailableTags rendering, addTagToFilter
URL persistence via safeReplaceState, and the tableToEntityType mapping
used by the htmx:afterSettle handler.

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
commits.author: Mihai Criveti

commits.message:
fix(ui): normalize filterEntitiesByTags to data-tag, remove leftover debug log

Address Codex review feedback:

- filterEntitiesByTags now uses [data-tag] selectors instead of fragile
  CSS-class selectors, aligning it with extractAvailableTags on the same
  DOM contract. This also unblocks JSDOM-based testing of non-empty tag
  filtering (previously skipped due to CSS comment syntax in selectors).
- Remove leftover console.log debug line in extractAvailableTags generic
  path (all other debug logging was already cleaned up).
- Add showTab("catalog") regression-path tests covering URL filter state
  restoration when navigating back to the Virtual Servers tab.
- Add filterEntitiesByTags tests exercising the data-tag contract:
  matching, non-matching, empty filter, and partial substring logic.

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
